_comment: DO NOT EDIT: FILE GENERATED FOR PTERODACTYL PANEL IMPORT
name: Pterodactyl Platform Bridge
author: TTLouis
description: Discord control and status bridge for Pterodactyl game servers. This preview Egg bootstraps Discord/Pterodactyl connectivity; server onboarding will move into the Discord admin channel.
startup: npm ci --omit=dev && node scripts/egg-bootstrap.js && node src/index.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates
rm -rf /mnt/server/*
git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BRIDGE_GIT_REF}" https://github.com/TTLouis/Pterodactyl-Discord-Bridge-Bot.git /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
echo "Installed Pterodactyl Platform Bridge from ${BRIDGE_GIT_REF}."

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Bootstrap token from the Discord Developer Portal.

variables.name: Discord Guild ID
variables.description: Discord server (guild) that the bridge manages.

variables.name: Discord Admin Channel ID
variables.description: Private channel for bridge administration commands. Keep this separate from the log channel.

variables.name: Discord Status Channel ID
variables.description: Channel where the global status panel is published.

variables.name: Discord Log Channel ID
variables.description: Optional diagnostics/log channel. Administrative commands do not run here.

variables.name: Pterodactyl Panel URL
variables.description: Base URL of the Pterodactyl panel, for example https://panel.example.com.

variables.name: Pterodactyl Client API Key
variables.description: Client API key used to validate the panel connection, discover accessible servers, read resources/allocations, control power, and obtain console websocket credentials.

variables.name: Game Chat Relay
variables.description: Experimental. Leave disabled while the game <-> Discord relay is shelved.

variables.name: Bridge Git Ref
variables.description: Git branch or tag installed by this preview Egg. Use a version tag for public releases.
